description: A premium, bilingual (English/Arabic RTL) supermarket e-commerce experience for Faiha Co-operative Society, Kuwait. The design blends organic warmth (fresh produce, community trust) with high-end structural clarity. It avoids generic supermarket 'red/blue' palettes, opting for deep forest green and terracotta. The admin dashboard borrows from Swiss/High-Contrast principles for maximum operational clarity.

typography.notes: No Inter or generic sans for headings. Use CSS logical variables to switch font-family globally based on the [dir='rtl'] attribute.

spacing_and_layout.storefront_grid: Bento Grid approach for homepage (e.g., Hero spanning 8 cols, secondary promos 4 cols). Wide gaps (gap-8). Generous container paddings (p-6 to p-12).
spacing_and_layout.product_cards: Minimalist, rounded-2xl surfaces. Inner padding p-5. Image max-height constrained. 'Add to Cart' button spans full width of card at bottom.
spacing_and_layout.admin_grid: Control Room approach. High density, gap-4 to gap-6. Every widget full height.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Soft organic curves for storefront (rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for primary buttons). Sharp utility for admin (rounded-md, 1px solid borders).

rtl_guidelines.critical_rule: NEVER use left/right utilities (e.g., ml-4, pr-2, left-0).
rtl_guidelines.required_utilities: MUST use logical properties native to Tailwind: ms-*, me-*, ps-*, pe-*, start-*, end-*. text-start, text-end.
rtl_guidelines.icons: Flip directional icons (arrows, chevrons, cart direction) using 'rtl:-scale-x-100'.

navigation.desktop: Crystal Glass sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Visible category links, prominent Language Toggle (EN/عربي), Search Bar, and Cart drawer trigger.
navigation.mobile: Bottom fixed navigation bar for core routes (Home, Categories, Cart, Account), plus top header for Search.

product_card.visual: Flat white background, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows default. Hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle ambient shadow.
product_card.price_display: Emphasize KD currency with 3 decimals (e.g., KD 1.250).
product_card.actions: Quantity increment/decrement built into the 'Add' button post-click.

cart_checkout.cart: Slide-out drawer (sheet component). Must respect RTL side (slides from right in LTR, slides from left in RTL).
cart_checkout.checkout: Guest checkout allowed. Accordion style for Delivery Address -> Payment (COD or KNET). Trust signals visible.

admin_dashboard.style: Cardless or very subtle 1px border cards. Dense data tables (Shadcn Table) with sticky headers. Use Recharts for KPIs.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Product cards: group-hover image scale (scale-105 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out). Buttons: active:scale-95.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer motion fade and slight slide-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1) on section scroll.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hero_backgrounds.description: Vegetables and fruits display, organic and fresh, suitable for a storefront hero background with a gradient overlay (bg-black/30) to make text readable.
Premium bakery scene for the Bakery category highlight.

lifestyle_and_community.description: Middle Eastern family shopping, emphasizing the Faiha Co-op community focus.

products_placeholders.description: Fresh produce items for product card placeholders.
Croissants for bakery product card placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with the custom colors provided.
Install Google Fonts (Outfit, Figtree, Cairo, Tajawal) and configure in CSS to switch based on html[dir='rtl'].
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for high-end duotone/regular icons.
Implement language context toggle that dynamically changes document.dir to 'rtl' or 'ltr'.
Strictly use logical margin/padding (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-) across ALL components.
Build Shadcn components natively with Tailwind RTL variants (e.g., rtl:space-x-reverse, logical padding).
Ensure 'KD' currency formatting explicitly uses 3 decimal places across cart, product, and admin pages.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
